findings.claim: Deleting lineage_test.go also removes the only visible coverage of the memorycard adapter's own lineage and mirror reporting (memorycard.NewSource, cardSource.Candidates and ByID) and the compile-time assertion that *memorycard.Source satisfies promote.Source. evidence: The diff only removes code from app.go, cmd_sync.go and rundeps.go; the retained imports and call sites are not visible, so a compile break from an import left unused cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
